name: 993 interior door pull handle, load-path (bionic) grip (PicoGK)
material_candidate: polymer (SLS/MJF PA12 class), grade to be determined after load test
picogk_enhancement: Bionic: the legs and grip between the two mounting bosses are grown by 3D SIMP topology optimization (source/bionic.json, topopt.py; 1.5 mm elements, 26 % of the F0 160 x 24 x 53 mm envelope, 35 mm hand passage kept empty) around a 14 mm grip core, under ASSUMED grip loads (400 N pull out, 250 N + 300 N oblique pulls both ways, 300 N push in, 150 N + 150 N side pull), bosses clamped on the door face; PicoGK smooths it into organic branching legs and fuses bosses, grip core and pilot bores exactly. Envelope check is against the F0 hypothesis (design domain), not a measured handle.

length_mm.note: F0 grip span (scripts/build_993_concept_f0.py, hypothesis); handle not measured

grip_thickness_mm.note: F0 grip thickness hypothesis; reached at mid span

height_mm.note: F0 overall height (35 mm hand passage + 18 mm grip)

boss_diameter_mm.note: mounting boss diameter, equal to the F0 post width

boss_height_mm.note: boss height above the door face

pilot_bore_mm.note: generic pilot bore placeholder; the real fastener and interface are unknown

pilot_depth_mm.note: blind bore depth from the door face

grip_swell_ratio.note: mid-span section is 25 percent fuller than at the ends

finger_scallop_depth_mm.note: scallop depth into the local underside

boss_blend_mm.note: blend radius between grip and bosses

open_interfaces: mounting interface on the door panel (fastener type, positions, torque) unknown
true handle shape to be acquired by scaled photogrammetry
status: F0 concept geometry - not fitted, not tested, not safe, not released, not a print file
